name: @librocat/server
description: The librocat MCP server (internal). The built bundle ships inside the Agent Plugin repo as server/main.js. The npm package `librocat` is a pointer with no code.

scripts.build:
esbuild src/main.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node20 --outfile=dist/main.js --banner:js="#!/usr/bin/env node
import { createRequire } from 'node:module'; const require = createRequire(import.meta.url);"
